registration.title: Wider gaps between leagues in cup ties
registration.what: In a match between clubs of different leagues, widen the expected margin in proportion to the gap between the two leagues' levels (by a tenth).
registration.why: From 2024 the side from the higher league did better in cup and European ties than the model expected.
registration.how: One number, chosen on 2023/24, applied to the 7% of matches that are between leagues.
registration.hypothesis: The gaps between leagues are too small; widening them improves cross-league matches.
registration.success_criteria: The standing bar: result log loss better by at least 0.002 on held-out matches, with the interval excluding zero, Brier agreeing and the same direction in each season. Over all matches. A second bar on the changed matches alone asked for the same direction on test and holdout.

events.label: Cross-league matches, July 2024 onwards
events.meaningful: Helps recent seasons on the matches it touches; worth 0.0002 over all matches.

events.label: Cross-league matches, 2021/22 and 2022/23
events.meaningful: Worse, with the interval excluding zero. The sign changes between periods, so a fixed correction is wrong for one or the other.

events.reason: The error moves over time: the higher-league side did 0.17 goals worse than projected before 2023 and 0.10 better since.
